A plain {"words": [...]} is one root leaf with unit origins. Words are literal on the refined base (block j has o_j atoms), priced by Lemma 1 with formula (6), literal lift at z = 0, e_j, 2e_j, e_j+e_{j+1}, (1..1) above o and at box points l, l+e_j, l+2e_j for LP support words. Leaf passes iff the exact LP optimum of criterion (8) is < 1 with unbounded slopes <= m-2, T(l) = T_m(m+sum l); CERTIFIED iff every leaf passes; gap = max leaf gap; BOUNDARY iff not certified and gap 0. Sandbox, CPU limits, source guard, invalid gap 4000 and the combined score are bound-contract-2's.
